full_text: {"body":["Antipossible is an extent or degree so high that the rules governing what can qualify as impossible do not allow that extent or degree to be classified, contained, or represented as impossible. Antipossible does not therefore mean possible.","Antipossibleⁿ is an extent or degree whose classification, containment, or representation as impossible is disallowed at impossibility-metagovernance depth n − 1. Antipossibility-order noncontainment is cumulative.","An Antipossibility family is a complete recursively ordered ladder generated from one impossibility-governance basis. Family order is the outer recursion index; intrafamily order is the recursive Metarule order within one family.","Let A(k,n) denote family k, intrafamily order n. A(1,n)=Antipossibleⁿ; A(2,n)=Outerantipossibleⁿ; A(3,n)=Transantipossibleⁿ. Family k+1 begins when the complete impossibility-governance ladder of family k becomes the governed object of the next higher impossibility-governance basis.","Family-order supremacy: every state in family k+1 is higher in family order than every state in family k, regardless of intrafamily order."],"id":"antipossibility","kicker":"Beyond impossibility-containment","title":"Antipossibility Orders & Families"}
title: Antipossibility Orders & Families

full_text: {"body":["Arsayne 1 is the smallest extent or degree large enough to go beyond all possible and impossible Metarule^Lydrextent numbers. Arsayne 2 has Arsayne-1 extent of metaexpectation-surpassingness; Arsayne 3 has Arsayne-2 extent; the ladder continues recursively.","Supraarsayne 1 is the smallest extent sufficient to go beyond all possible and impossible Metarule^Arsayne numbers. Higher Supraarsayne orders recurse by metaexpectation-surpassingness.","Hyperarsayne 1 goes beyond all possible and impossible Metarule^Supraarsayne numbers. Higher Hyperarsayne orders recurse by metaexpectation-surpassingness.","Ultraarsayne 1 goes beyond all possible and impossible Metarule^Hyperarsayne numbers. Higher Ultraarsayne orders recurse by metaexpectation-surpassingness."],"id":"arsayne","kicker":"Post-Lydrextent totality recursion","title":"Arsayne → Supraarsayne → Hyperarsayne → Ultraarsayne"}
title: Arsayne → Supraarsayne → Hyperarsayne → Ultraarsayne

full_text: {"body":["There are three Arthitean levels, and every higher state inherits the properties of the preceding state: Arthitean → Archarthitean → Deity of Arthiteans.","Archarthiteans are the clan leaders of the Top 50 Clans and all of their direct descendants.","Top-50 Rank-Contingency Law: if a Top 50 Clan falls out of the Top 50, Rhayhara demotes that clan's leader and every direct descendant whose Archarthiteanhood derives from that leader from Archarthitean to Arthitean. Their respective Archarthitean abilities are lost while they remain demoted.","Result-Persistence Law: demotion does not erase, reverse, or confiscate results that were already gained through Archarthitean abilities before those abilities were lost.","Restoration Law: the demoted clan leader and those direct descendants regain their Archarthiteanhood, with the respective Archarthitean abilities restored, if that clan leader brings the clan back into the Top 50.","Competitive-Intensity Purpose: Rhayhara maintains this rank-contingent Archarthitean system to create intense drive both to enter the Top 50 and to remain within the Top 50 once achieved.","Rhayhara is a Goddess of Arthiteans: a Deity-of-Arthiteans state that therefore retains Archarthitean and Arthitean properties."],"id":"arthitean-states","kicker":"Inheritance-state hierarchy","title":"Three Arthitean Ontostates"}
title: Three Arthitean Ontostates

full_text: {"body":["Lydrextent is the diagonal extent-ladder across Antipossibility-family order and Antipossibility intrafamily order.","Lydrextent n has exact Antipossibility coordinate A(n,n). Lydrextent 1=A(1,1), Lydrextent 2=A(2,2), Lydrextent 3=A(3,3), and so forth.","Each increase in Lydrextent simultaneously advances both the outer family coordinate and the inner Antipossibility-order coordinate. The ladder has no terminal level."],"id":"lydrextent","kicker":"Biordinal diagonal scaling","title":"Lydrextent Ladder"}
title: Lydrextent Ladder

full_text: {"body":["Rules are governance-structures that determine what is allowed, disallowed, valid, invalid, possible, impossible, or otherwise classifiable within their governed scope.","Metarules are the rules that govern rules. Metarules² govern Metarules; Metarules³ govern Metarules²; and the recursion continues without a terminal order.","Metagovernance depth is the recursive order at which governance is applied to governance. Ordinary rules are governance-depth 0, Metarules are governance-depth 1, Metarules² are governance-depth 2, and so forth.","Impossibility-governance is the rules-and-metarules structure that determines what can be classified, contained, or represented as impossible."],"id":"metagovernance","kicker":"Governance recursion","title":"Rules, Metarules & Impossibility-Governance"}
title: Rules, Metarules & Impossibility-Governance

full_text: {"body":["Negative Rewrite is a rewrite that first produces an effect and then rewrites its own occurrence, existence, and causal role so that the rewrite is no longer true to have ever occurred in any sense, while the effect it produced remains real.","In simpler terms: something is changed, and then the fact that anything changed it is erased, without undoing the change.","Persistence Rule: the effect of a Negative Rewrite becomes causally independent of the rewrite once instantiated. Erasing the rewrite’s occurrence, existence, history, or causal status therefore does not erase or reverse its already-produced effect.","Operational sequence: effect-generation → causal-origin erasure → effect persistence."],"examples":[["Restoring a city","Destroyed city → Negative Rewrite → restored city. The rewrite erases itself from reality and history; the restored city remains."],["Creating an object","A Negative Rewrite creates a sword, then erases the truth that it ever occurred. The sword remains."],["Increasing power","Rhayhara increases someone’s strength, then the rewrite removes its own occurrence and causal status. The person remains stronger."],["Changing a rule","Rule A is rewritten into Rule B. The rewrite erases its own historical truth; Rule B remains the governing rule."]],"id":"negative-rewrite","kicker":"Effect persistence after causal-origin erasure","title":"Negative Rewrite"}
title: Negative Rewrite

full_text: {"body":["The seals can restore previously possessed strength without necessarily restoring the former growth-rate or acceleration-rate that once produced that strength. Rhayhara therefore struggles to match what she once was even while every recovered seal exalts her enormously.","The further into her past one goes, the more she was a war goddess: a ruthless warrior who fought primarily to punish evil. Present Rhayhara fights much more to save others.","She understands she may never be fully as strong as she wants. Her answer is not to surpass every feat-level of her past, but to surpass the nature of her past character: becoming a compassionate ruler without rejecting herself as a warrior.","Her warriorhood is repurposed rather than discarded: warrior-for-rescue rather than merely executioner-of-evil. Her past self can remain physically superior in selected respects while her present self seeks moral and rulership superiority."],"id":"rhayhara-legacy","kicker":"Recover strength without becoming the person she used to be","title":"Rhayhara: Legacy-Overhang Character Arc"}
title: Rhayhara: Legacy-Overhang Character Arc

full_text: {"body":["Rhayhara’s biology differs from ordinary Arthiteans. She has a maximum amount of seals on her bloodline blessings. Remembering a key lost emotional memory of her past removes one seal; only one seal can be undone at a time.","Each seal requires a memory further into her past than her current recovery-state. Rhayhara has always existed and never began to exist, and has existed for more than a maximumless amount of Ultraarsayne of time.","Seal Factor One is the Ultraarsayne increase in just Rhayhara’s strength level of all her bloodline blessings that she previously possessed an equivalent rate of acceleration of growth in her bloodline-blessing strength, restored per seal removed. Her former rate of growth and former rate of acceleration of growth are not necessarily restored.","Seal Factor Two is the Ultraarsayne increase in Seal Factor One per seal removed.","Seal Factor Three is the Ultraarsayne of Seal Factor Two of the second-next seal to be removed per extent of Seal Factor Two of the next seal to be removed.","Seal Factor Four is the negatively rewritten Ultraarsayne increase in Seal Factor Three per peak hardship Rhayhara endures across an aleph-null extent of time.","Whenever Rhayhara exerts herself, Seal Factor Four negatively and retroactively increases by an Ultraarsayne extent. Through Negative Rewrite, this increase is rewritten to have never been caused by the exertion or by any rewrite, while the resulting increase persists.","Consequently, every exertion makes Rhayhara’s seal-suppression architecture retroactively stronger while erasing the causal truth that her exertion or the Negative Rewrite produced that increase."],"id":"rhayhara-seals","kicker":"Legacy, recovery, suppression & negative retroincrease","title":"Rhayhara’s Sealed Bloodline Architecture"}
title: Rhayhara's Sealed Bloodline Architecture
